name: oracle_champion_refined_crossover
patch_description:
Base: Program 2 (champion at 0.79 combined score, 76.25% WR).

Crossover additions:
1. `_already_selling` helper from Program 3 for cleaner code and reduced redundancy
2. `player_idx` in farm_state for metadata
3. Day-29 phased liquidation batch increased from 6 to 7 (compromise between P2's 6 and P3's 8)
4. Conservative quiet-window batch boost: non-demanded items get batch_max=3 (instead of 2) when opponent is very quiet (score_24 < 0.10) - this captures more monopoly revenue per selling opportunity without the cadence-every-turn problem that hurt Program 3
5. Start phased day-29 liquidation at step 693 instead of 696 (3 extra turns of orderly selling)
6. Fert price floor lowered from 0.50 to 0.45 (more aggressive monetization of a non-demanded product)

NOT including from Program 3 (these features all correlated with lower scores):
- Collision softening (reduces batch on score_1 signals that are wrong 50% of the time)
- Full every-turn quiet-window cadence (oversells and crashes own prices)
- Seat-asymmetric early liquidation timing (no demonstrated benefit)
- Oracle seed filter from Program 1 (Program 2 without it scored higher)

All of Program 2's proven advantages are preserved: WOOL 0.70, aggressive fert, urgency-based hand sorting, dynamic cadence bypass, mid-game premium asset shielding, monopoly pricing.
